actual_scope: Prove a logarithmic majorant for PR4359 leaf counts, certify smaller ranks at unchanged supplier savings, and retune the complete cover/atom/outer consumer to retain kappa 0.0023 at ranks 2^465000 and 2^7100.
scope_change_reason: Explicit user assignment to build on conditional-kappa-0023, followed by a request to shrink ranks further. The catalogue four-provider audit is replaced by a changed majorant and complete consumer-parameter retuning; no new kappa is claimed.
bottleneck_link: The majorant removes a squared inverse-gap loss; the complete consumer ledger allows the surplus supplier saving to be exchanged for smaller ambient ranks.
stop_rule: One proved majorant, two exact sufficient ranks and negative controls; no template materialization, H decoder campaign or full outer replay.
evidence: README.md proof and complete retuned consumer bill; RESULT.json exact checks; VENDOR.json immutable predecessor subset.
